It seemed to me it lay in this: that everything should be put away in a cupboard; that no object, no moulding on the wall or on the doors or furniture should remain outside to catch one speck of the dirt and grime of our cities; that all the dirt should reach the floor whence the electric suction sweeper should remove it.

brief_context: Mentioned as the author of 'My Philosophy of Industry'.
brief_extract: If that home really represented what woman to-day wants, it can only be because she has not thought of the possible. Henry Ford, in his recently published “My Philosophy of Industry,” deals briefly with this theme. His solution appears to be to follow in the case of daily meals what has already been done in that of bread, that is, have them prepared and cooked outside and delivered hot at the appropriate moment; the service articles, plates, cups, cutlery, are presumably to be collected and cleaned at the central factory.

Some Picnic Dishes By ... Mary MacKirdy

:: :: A Page for Girl Guides. Kathleen Baker, of the Wallsend Secondary School for Girls, describes a visit to Carliol
House, Newcastle-on-Tyne, where a film and demonstration gave the girls some idea
of how electricity is made and how it is used in the factory and in the home. On coming back to school after the holi-

title: Miss
brief_context: Conducted a demonstration of electric household appliances for visitors.
article_title: A Day in an All-Electric House.
brief_extract:
Thus ended “a perfect day in an all-electric house.”
This, then, is what we saw on the film, but it is better to describe it first so that we do know something about electricity before we use it for so many things. We were welcomed in the demonstration theatre by Miss Holm and in a few moments the demonstration had started. Miss Holm said she would do some washing for us, also some ironing, and she would bake an apple tart and make some bread, and also cook some vegetables.

title: Miss
brief_context: Demonstrated electric sweepers and floor appliances for the visitors.
brief_extract: We paid a short visit to the rooms where there were electric sweepers with their various additions and electric floor polishers and floor washers. The party had now divided into two sections, one following the showroom gentleman and one accompanied by Miss Holm, who demonstrated for us on the above-mentioned appliances. Time was short, so we returned downstairs, saw the accountancy department, also the repair department and the electric telephone, where calls could be put through to any part of Carliol House.

brief_context: Designed the beautiful fountain for Carliol House.
brief_extract: We saw ovens and the electric washers and mangles such as were used during the demonstrations and exactly like the one seen on the film. Finally the two parties assembled at the beautiful fountain designed for Carliol House by a girl student of Armstrong College.

The functions of art are many and debatable, but chief among them are the capacity to suggest the beauties of nature and to expand their statement and application. brief_extract: Then my friend opened her door and I was greeted by a flood of warm light from her little hall. "Yes," said Mary, "it is very cosy-looking, and just caused by a 15-watt lamp, sprayed flame colour to give that cheerful effect. brief_context: Hostess demonstrating her modern all-electric kitchen and home.
brief_extract:
58
The Electrical Age

How I loved that little kitchen, with its built-in, glass-fronted dresser, its large well-ventilated corner cupboard, its basin and sink, each provided with constant hot water, and its white " tiled " walls reflecting the light from a 40-watt inside-frosted lamp, so placed that it illuminated the interior of the cupboard when open. " I thought at first that I could manage with a lower wattage in a room only 6 feet square," Mary informed me, " but I found a dim light had a most depressing effect when I arrived home tired after my day's work, and the extra fillip to my spirits is well worth the very small extra cost of current. Here again," she confessed, " I should like another small outlet for my iron, but have to manage with this adaptor fixed to the lighting unit above the shade, with a switch on it which enables the iron to be used either with the light on or off.

“ Tell us more about Electricity ”
Says Mrs. Housewife and Miss Bachelor Girl. By VIOLET DISMORE.

brief_context: Reference to the story 'Alf's Button'.
article_title: “ Tell us more about Electricity ” Says Mrs. Housewife and Miss Bachelor Girl
brief_extract:
The modern housewife and her young
sister, the bachelor girl, want to know. Particularly they want to know about elec-
tricity, which has the ready magic of
Alf’s Button, without that button’s em-
barrassing consequences. There is never
any difficulty in getting together a crowd
of women to witness an electrical demon-
stration and they are quick to ask questions
and to find out the ultimate possibilities
of each electrical device.
